defs.def: feeling that you want to eat sth 感到饿的

ex.s: After a long non-stop flight, these passengers are tired and hungry.
ex.t: 经过长时间的不间断飞行后，这些乘客又累又饿。

ex.s: If a student gets hungry on the long drives to and from school, Wilson never   25   to buy them a meal.
ex.t: 如果学生在往返学校的长途车程中饿了，威尔逊从不___25___给他们买顿饭。

ex.s: She asked her mother why he did that and her mother said that the man was homeless and hungry.
ex.t: 她问妈妈为什么那个人要那样做，妈妈说那个人无家可归，而且很饿。

ex.s: However, I still left the restaurant feeling hungry, though I was much more aware of the challenges that blind people face.
ex.t: 然而，我离开餐厅时仍然觉得饿，尽管我比以前更清楚地意识到盲人所面临的挑战。

defs.def: not having enough food to eat 饥饿的；挨饿的

ex.s: For those extremely hungry there’s a large set menu.
ex.t: 对于极度饥饿的人，这里有大型套餐菜单。

ex.s: The hungry bear followed his nose to our camp，which was surrounded by a high wire fence.
ex.t: 那只饥饿的熊循着气味来到我们的营地，营地四周围着高高的铁丝网。

ex.s: So far there is no effective way to get rid of it, but a new study suggests an answer may lie in the stomachs of some hungry worms.
ex.t: 到目前为止，还没有有效的方法来摆脱它，但一项新研究表明答案可能在于某些饥饿蠕虫的胃里。

ex.s: What’s more, hungry animals are finding plenty to eat in our gardens and in the leftovers we throw away.
ex.t: 而且，饥饿的动物们在我们花园里和我们丢弃的剩饭中找到了大量的食物。

ex.s: Nonetheless, a menu for a hungry astronaut can still be varied and balanced, often including soup, prawn sandwiches, as well as fruit yoghurt.
ex.t: 尽管如此，为饥饿的宇航员准备的菜单仍然可以是多样化和均衡的，通常包括汤、虾三明治以及水果酸奶。

ex.s: Hot peanuts are a hit with hungry baseball fans, but the hot dog is the real winner!
ex.t: 热花生是饥饿的棒球迷的热门选择，但热狗才是真正的赢家！

ex.s: In a world where nearly 800 million people a year go hungry, “food waste goes against the moral grain,” as Elizabeth Royte writes in this month’s cover story.
ex.t: 在一个每年近8亿人挨饿的世界里，"食物浪费违背道德准则，"伊丽莎白·罗伊特在本月封面故事中写道。

defs.def: people who do not have enough food to eat （统称）饿民

ex.s: Different noises have a variety of meanings: they can mean “I am hungry”, “I am angry”, or “Good to see you!” An elephant’s body language includes ear signals and gestures.
ex.t: 不同的声音有多种含义：它们可以表示"我饿了"、"我生气了"或"很高兴见到你！"大象的肢体语言包括耳朵信号和手势。

defs.def: causing you to feel that you want to eat sth 使人饥饿的；引起食欲的

ex.s: If a pet cat is hungry, it will keep meowing to attract attention and find food.
ex.t: 如果宠物猫饿了，它会不停喵喵叫以引起注意并找到食物。

defs.def: having or showing a strong desire for sth 渴望得到；渴求
